## Table 1
General summary metrics on the assembly
```{r}
# Read Flye assembly
assembly <- readDNAStringSet("flye/bbd/assembly.fasta")
# Calculate contig lengths
contig_lengths <- width(assembly)
sorted_lengths <- sort(contig_lengths, decreasing = TRUE)

# Calculate N50
cumulative_length <- cumsum(sorted_lengths)
n50 <- sorted_lengths[
  which(cumulative_length >= sum(sorted_lengths) / 2)[1]
]

# Create Table 1
assembly_table <- data.frame(
  Metric = c(
    "Total assembly length",
    "Number of contigs",
    "N50",
    "Longest contig",
    "Mean contig length",
    "Median contig length"
  ),
  Value = c(
    paste0(round(sum(contig_lengths) / 1e6, 2), " Mb"),
    format(length(contig_lengths), big.mark = ","),
    paste0(format(n50, big.mark = ","), " bp"),
    paste0(format(max(contig_lengths), big.mark = ","), " bp"),
    paste0(format(round(mean(contig_lengths)), big.mark = ","), " bp"),
    paste0(format(round(median(contig_lengths)), big.mark = ","), " bp")
  )
)

knitr::kable(
  assembly_table,
  caption = "Table 1. Summary statistics for the black band disease metagenome assembly generated with Flye.",
  align = c("l", "r")
)
```


To answer "what organisms make up the largest components of the assembly?" -- RESULTS FROM GTD
```{r}
gtdbtk <- read_tsv("gtdbtk/gtdbtk.bac120.summary.tsv")

gtdbtkTABLE <- gtdbtk |> separate_longer_delim(classification, delim = ";") |>
  group_by(user_genome) |>
  slice_tail(n=3) |>
  summarise(short_classification = paste(classification, collapse =""))

gtdbtkTABLE

```

## GC content

```{r figure1-gc, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}

gc_content <- letterFrequency(assembly, letters = c("G", "C"))

gc_df <- tibble(
  GC = rowSums(gc_content) / width(assembly)
)

ggplot(gc_df, aes(x = GC)) +
  geom_histogram(
    binwidth = 0.025,
    fill = "black",
    colour = "white"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "GC content",
    y = "Number of contigs"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12)
```

```{r}
checkm_lines <- readLines("checkm/checkm_results_bbd.txt")

# Keep actual bin-result lines only
checkm_lines <- checkm_lines[
  grepl("^(contig_|metabat\\.)", trimws(checkm_lines))
]

# Split whitespace-delimited CheckM output
checkm_split <- strsplit(trimws(checkm_lines), "\\s+")

checkm_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(checkm_split, function(x) {
  data.frame(
    bin = x[1],
    lineage = x[2],
    completeness = as.numeric(x[13]),
    contamination = as.numeric(x[14])
  )
}))

checkm_df
```

```{r}
JoinedTable <- checkm_df |> 
  left_join(gtdbtkTABLE, by = c("bin" = "user_genome"))


```



Estimated completeness of genome bins recovered from the black band disease metagenome, calculated using CheckM.
```{r figure2-bin-completeness, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}

checkm_top <- JoinedTable |>
  filter(completeness > 15) |>
  arrange(completeness)

ggplot(
  checkm_top,
  aes(
    x = completeness,
    y = reorder(short_classification, completeness)
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    fill = "black",
    width = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0(round(completeness, 1), "%")),
    hjust = -0.15,
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 105),
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 20),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Genome completeness (%)",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(colour = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(colour = "black")
  )
```
